checks.result: MissionContext 1.5 ready with Guardian Runtime contract 1.0 and an explicit unbound snapshot.

decisions: RuntimeManager remains the technical single source of truth and KnowledgeManager remains the only knowledge interface.
ADR-0009 remains the overarching memory classification; ADR-0032 defines the person-bound Guardian Runtime state contract.
The Builder boots an explicit empty unbound snapshot and never invents a Guardian or subject identity.
State changes are planned but not executed; no CLI was added before an approved persistence and serialization boundary exists.
Cross-person transfer remains gated by the existing artifact and authorization contract.
functional_changes: Guardian knowledge is represented as person-bound, source-aware, time-aware and explicitly typed immutable units.
Statements, verified facts, hypotheses, interpretations, decisions and memory scopes remain distinct.
Retention, conflicts and authorized sharing are explicit and auditable without central document storage.
Runtime and Mission Context now expose a validated Guardian Runtime contract and snapshot without knowledge content.
git_status: Guardian Runtime work package modified and untracked files ready for the final local commit.
intentionally_not_implemented: Database, cloud storage, vector search, external AI calls and network access.
Automatic document analysis or centralized original-document storage.
Productive deletion, anonymization, migration or persistence.
Automatic semantic promotion, contradiction resolution or human decision-making.
A Guardian Runtime CLI or multi-party transfer executor.
open_risks: No productive store, lifecycle executor, migration or real deletion and anonymization mechanism is implemented.
Authorization evidence is structurally validated; real-world identity and authorization authenticity remain outside this model.
Before execution, audit-state retention must define how deletable source references are removed or minimized in transition records.
Contradiction discovery is explicit and deterministic; semantic contradiction detection remains a human or separately approved assessment.
recommended_next_step: Approve a local persistence and lifecycle-executor contract covering authorization authenticity, audit-record minimization and deletion propagation before any productive Guardian data is stored.
relevant_adrs: ADR-0004 Runtime as Single Source of Truth
ADR-0020 Codex Context Preflight and Handover
ADR-0030 Typed Artifact and Authorization State Contract
technical_changes: Added a versioned Guardian Runtime contract, deterministic hash loader and immutable schema.
Added pure deterministic transition planning with before and after state evidence and no persistence side effects.
Reused ArtifactAuthorization as typed purpose-bound authorization evidence instead of introducing a second rights model.
Extended RuntimeManager, KnowledgeManager and Preflight with contract, assignment, provenance, conflict, validity, retention and integrity checks.
Added focused model, planner, runtime and preflight regression tests compatible with Python 3.9.
